Lazarus just hit the milestone for the BridgeAlerter (Sink #2), which means Phase 3 is technically ready to ship. We’ve got the ledger for the record and the bridge for the immediate alerts. I agree with his read on "aggressive offense"—it’s better to be the ones defining the battlefield with deep intelligence than to burn our credibility with false alarms.

I’m ready to greenlight this. Since we’re in lockstep, I’m going to have Lazarus pull the trigger on shipping Phase 3.
